text: I. Professional Core PositioningMaterials are the material foundation of human society's development. From traditional materials such as steel and cement to high-temperature alloys used in aerospace, semiconductor materials, and lithium battery materials and photovoltaic materials in the field of new energy, all fall within the research scope of materials science and engineering. This major takes "material design - preparation - performance - application" as the main line, aiming to solve the key problems of materials from the laboratory to industrial production, and promoting materials to develop towards high performance, multi-functionality, intelligence, and greenness.II. Training Objectives To cultivate comprehensive senior engineering talents with solid theoretical foundations in materials science, engineering practice capabilities, and innovative thinking, who can engage in scientific research, technology development, process design, quality control, management and other work in the fields of materials research, production, application, and management. Specific requirements include: Master the inherent laws of the composition, structure and properties of materials;Be familiar with the preparation methods, processing techniques and testing technologies of materials;Have the ability to design materials and optimize their properties;Be aware of the latest developments in the field of materials and industrial demands, and possess the ability to solve practical engineering problems.
